hero.subtitle: Experience the next generation of seamless communication with military-grade privacy, instant AI speech translation, and crystal-clear HD audio/video calls.

features_section.subtitle: Discover next-generation communication tools designed to keep your personal life private and your business conversations seamlessly productive.
features_section.card_translation_desc: Break language barriers instantaneously. Speak in your native language, and CallsChat auto-translates speech and text into 100+ languages in real time.
features_section.card_secret_desc: Ultra-secure end-to-end encrypted rooms featuring automated screenshot blocking, forward restriction, and self-destruct timers.
features_section.card_dual_desc: Switch effortlessly between encrypted 1v1 personal conversations and collaborative corporate workspaces with shared inboxes.
features_section.card_safety_desc: Real-time client-side intelligence detecting phishing URLs, scam attacks, and impersonation attempts before you tap.
features_section.card_calls_desc: Crystal-clear calls powered by LiveKit WebRTC, featuring intelligent background noise suppression and sub-30ms global latency.
features_section.card_business_desc: Empower your support teams with multi-agent inbox assignments, SLA trackers, and internal note collaboration.

dual_mode_section.subtitle: No more carrying two phones or juggling multiple apps. CallsChat provides completely separated, dedicated environments for your private conversations and professional team workspaces.
dual_mode_section.personal_desc: Stay close to friends and family with zero-knowledge encryption, disappearing media, and pure private communication.
dual_mode_section.personal_voice_caption: "Hey! Dinner is at 7pm tonight. Don't forget! 🍕"
dual_mode_section.business_desc: Accelerate your enterprise support with shared multi-agent inboxes, automated AI dispatching, SLA monitoring, and CRM integrations.
dual_mode_section.business_customer_msg: "Can we upgrade our workspace to 100 seats with SAML SSO?"
dual_mode_section.business_feat_3: Custom Webhooks, REST APIs & CRM Sync
dual_mode_section.bridge_desc: Switch effortlessly between your personal chats and enterprise support hub with a single tap. Zero logout friction, completely isolated database silos.
